Mobile Handbook FAQ
blocks.summary: 8 short questions and answers on the mobile version of the casino.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 8 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) is there a store app to download (no: the casino opens in the browser and is added to the home screen as a shortcut); (2) which phones work (Android, iOS and the mobile web of smartphones and tablets); (3) how the Android shortcut is added (open the casino website in Chrome, choose Add to Home screen in the browser menu, confirm the shortcut); (4) how the iOS shortcut is added (open the casino website in Safari, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, confirm Add); (5) what a player can do from a phone (casino, sportsbook, account access, deposits, withdrawals, bonuses); (6) whether the sportsbook is on the phone too (yes: the sportsbook is one of the features of the mobile website); (7) how a player logs in on a phone (with the registered e-mail and password, as on a computer); (8) where to turn when something fails (customer support: live chat 24/7 or e-mail; do not print the e-mail address). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not say or imply that a native app, an APK or IPA file, a file download, an app-store listing (Google Play, App Store), a version number, push notifications, fingerprint or Face ID login, an offline mode, an in-app chat, or system requirements (OS versions, storage, memory, internet speed) exist: none of them is given. Mobile access is the responsive website in the browser of a smartphone or a tablet, plus a home-screen shortcut.
